Newport Performing Arts Theater.fact: The Newport Performing Arts Theater (NPAT), also called simply Newport Theater, is a performing arts center on the grounds of Newport World Resorts in Pasay, Metro Manila, Philippines. The 1,500-seat facility opened in 2010 and holds the widest stage in the Philippines.
